programme.title: Spider-Man 2, film
programme.desc: Nakon dvije godine Peter Parker se nalazi pred novim izazovima mireći u sebi svoj 'dar i prokletstvo'. Kao student na koledžu, mučen svojom tajnom, otkriva da su odnosi sa svima koji su mu dragi u opasnosti saznaju li njegov tajni identitet. Parkerova žudnja za Mary Jane postaje sve jača dok se bori sa željom da joj otkrije svoje drugo lice i izjavi joj ljubav. Prijateljstvo s Harryjem Osbornom nagriženo je Harryjevom željom da osveti oca i uništi Spider-mana. Čak i njegova teta May, shrvana nakon smrti svoga muža, gaji sumnje prema nećaku Peteru. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kad mu se suprotstavi novi negativac Dr. Otto Octavius - Doc Ock.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Šašavi detektiv, film
programme.desc: Detektiv Ace Ventura (Jim Carrey) istražuje i rješava zagonetne slučajeve. No, on nije običan detektiv, njegova profesionalnost isključivo su životinje. Jednog dana Ace prima poziv od Melisse Robinson (Courtney Cox) koja ga angažira da pronađe čuvenu maskotu ragbi tima Miami Dolphinsa, simpatičnog dupina Snježnu Pahuljicu. Ace se odmah zdušno baca na zadatak, a Melissa požali što ga je angažirala. Naime, njegove metode rada su prilično neprihvatljive i uznemirujuće za okolinu. Premda izgleda glupo i nekompetentno, Ace Ventura zna što radi, a njegov način rada, iako neobičan, prilično je djelotvoran. Da stvar bude još neobičnija, Melissa shvaća da ju ovaj čudni detektiv počinje privlačiti.

programme.title: Početak kraja, film
programme.desc: Vatikan, 1979. Sveti Otac (M. Margolis) prima obavijest da će upravo biti rođena djevojčica za koju proročanstvo tvrdi da će za dvadeset godina postati Sotoninom nevjestom. Rođenje njihovog djeteta označit će kraj čovječanstva... New York, dvadeset godina kasnije. Cijela je zemlja u iščekivanju dolaska 2000. godine pri čemu se jedni raduju neviđenom slavlju, a drugi upozoravaju na moguće probleme. Bivši policajac Jericho Cane (A. Schwarzenegger) na rubu je samoubojstva otkako je tragično izgubio obitelj. Sa svojim partnerom Bobbyjem (K. Pollak) radi kao stručnjak za sigurnost i zbog depresije sve više pije. Kad u gradu zaredaju neobične nesreće, Jericho se nađe usred ostvarenja proročanstva koje kaže da će Sotona (G. Byrne) uoči dolaska 2000. godine potražiti novu nevjestu. To je dvadesetogodišnja Christine York (R. Tunney) koja godinama pati od strašnih vizija... Iako su u drugoj polovici devedesetih zaredali apokaliptični filmovi katastrofe, malo se filmova bavilo konkretnim prijelazom u novi milenij ili barem 2000. godinom. Jedan je od tih rijetkih projekata povratnički film Arnolda Schwarzeneggera (Istinite laži, serijal Terminator), snimljen nakon njegovih višegodišnjih problema sa srcem, ali i debakla s "Batmanom i Robinom" (1997). Osmišljen kao glumčev povratak mračnijim zapletima, "End of Days" trebao je s jedne strane zaintrigirati kao uznemirujuća vizija skorog završetka 20. stoljeća, a s druge kao spoj misterije, akcije i strave u kojem će šira publika pronaći nešto po svom ukusu. Za redatelja je angažiran stručnjak za znanstvenu fantastiku Peter Hyams (2010: Druga Odiseja, Vremenski policajac), a scenarij je napisao Andrew W. Marlowe (Air Force One, Čovjek bez tijela). Policajca "na rubu" tumači Schwarzenegger dok je Sotonu utjelovio G. Byrne (Privedite osumnjičene, Stigmata) efektno se poigravši s mogućnostima takvog lika. Između njih našla se mlada R. Tunney, slavodobitnica u Veneciji (Niagara, Niagara), dok su u ostalim ulogama K. Pollak, zatim TV zvijezda CCH Pounder (serije Na rubu zakona i Hitna služba) te pokojni oskarovac R. Steiger (U vrelini noći, Na dokovima New Yorka). Redatelj Hyams nije se ustručavao šokantnijih prizora, ni što se tiče nasilja, ni što se tiče erotike (uz to, filmovi mu plijene osebujnom fotografijom s obzirom da pri snimanju preferira prirodno svjetlo).

programme.title: Blade Runner 2, film
programme.desc: Trideset godina nakon događaja iz prvog filma novi istrebljivač, losanđeleski policajac K (Ryan Gosling), otkriva dugo skrivenu tajnu koja može dovesti ono što je ostalo od društva u stanje kaosa. To otkriće odvest će ga u potragu za Rickom Deckardom (Harrison Ford), bivšim losanđeleskim istrebljivačem koji je nestao prije 30 godina.

programme.title: Predigra za brak, film
programme.desc: Kao desetogodišnji dječak, Chuck (Dane Cook) je prekršio glavno pravilo igre Boca istine kad je odbio poljubiti poremećenu darkericu. Slomljena njegovim obeshrabrujućim odbijanjem i odlučna u tome da uništi bilo kakvu priliku da Chuck ikad nađe pravu ljubav, osvetoljubiva djevojka baca kletvu na kukavičkog kršitelja pravila koja ga prati i kao odraslog čovjeka. Dvadesetak godina kasnije Chuck je uspješan zubar koji jednostavno ne može održati stabilnu vezu. Jednog dana, na vjenčanju bivše djevojke, Chuck shvaća da je svaka djevojka s kojom je ikad izlazio našla pravu ljubav sa sljedećim muškarcem kojeg je srela. Kad se pročuje da je Chuck nešto kao amajlija za žene koje se žele udati, svaka žena u bližoj i daljoj okolini želi seks na jednu noć. Chucku ne treba dugo da shvati kako je isprazan seks bez prave ljubavi. Nakon što je upoznao Cam (Jessica Alba), Chuck počinje shvaćati da je našao ženu svojih snova, ali što će se dogoditi s njihovom vezom ako Chuck i Cam spavaju zajedno? Da bi spriječio da Cam završi sa sljedećim tipom kojeg sretne, Chuck će konačno pokušati poništiti kletvu koja ga muči još od djetinjstva.

programme.title: Iluzionist, film
programme.desc: U filmu Iluzionist isprepliču se ljubavna priča, politika i magija. Edward Norton i Paul Giamatti glume dvojicu muškaraca suprotstavljenih u borbi umova. Norton glumi tajnovitog mađioničara Eisenheima, a Giamatti je pronicljivi bečki inspektor Uhl, čovjek od zakona u čijemu svijetu nema mjesta za magiju. Jessica Biel glumi lijepu i zagonetnu Sophie von Teschen čija se budućnost potpuno mijenja nakon susreta s Eisenheimom koji prijeti da će otkriti mračne tajne monarhije koje ona čuva.

programme.title: Iluzionist, film
programme.desc: U filmu Iluzionist isprepliču se ljubavna priča, politika i magija. Edward Norton i Paul Giamatti glume dvojicu muškaraca suprotstavljenih u borbi umova. Norton glumi tajnovitog mađioničara Eisenheima, a Giamatti je pronicljivi bečki inspektor Uhl, čovjek od zakona u čijemu svijetu nema mjesta za magiju. Jessica Biel glumi lijepu i zagonetnu Sophie von Teschen čija se budućnost potpuno mijenja nakon susreta s Eisenheimom koji prijeti da će otkriti mračne tajne monarhije koje ona čuva.

programme.title: Zmija u sjeni orla, film
programme.desc: Chien Fu (Jackie Chan) je dječak koji radi kao nadstojnik u školi kung-fua. Ne zna se boriti i stalno ga maltretiraju učenici i učitelji. Jednoga dana mudri starac mu pokaže vještine kung-fu-a. Nakon toga Chien Fua više nitko ne gnjavi… Glavni glumac filma 'Zmija u sjeni orla' Jackie Chan najbolji je prijatelj Sylvestera Stallonea.

programme.title: Ljudi u crnom: Globalna prijetnja, film
programme.desc: Ljudi u crnom proširili su se na cijeli svijet, ali isto vrijedi i za svemirsku gamad. A da bi nas čuvali, odlikovani agent H (Chris Hemsworth) i odlučna novakinja M (Tessa Thompson) udruženi su u partnerstvo - malo vjerojatan par koji bi možda mogao funkcionirati. Kad se suoče s novom izvanzemaljskom prijetnjom koja može poprimiti oblik bilo koga, uključujući agente MIB-ja, moraju udružiti snage u globalnoj pustolovini kako bi spasili agenciju, a na kraju i svijet.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2, film
programme.desc: Nakon dvije godine Peter Parker se nalazi pred novim izazovima mireći u sebi svoj 'dar i prokletstvo'. Kao student na koledžu, mučen svojom tajnom, otkriva da su odnosi sa svima koji su mu dragi u opasnosti saznaju li njegov tajni identitet. Parkerova žudnja za Mary Jane postaje sve jača dok se bori sa željom da joj otkrije svoje drugo lice i izjavi joj ljubav. Prijateljstvo s Harryjem Osbornom nagriženo je Harryjevom željom da osveti oca i uništi Spider-mana. Čak i njegova teta May, shrvana nakon smrti svoga muža, gaji sumnje prema nećaku Peteru. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kad mu se suprotstavi novi negativac Dr. Otto Octavius - Doc Ock.

programme.title: Fantomasov povratak, film
programme.desc: Kad poznati znanstvenik profesor Marchand misteriozno nestane, komesar Juve odmah posumnja u Fantômasa... "Fantomas" je 1964. bio odgovor Francuske na fenomen Jamesa Bonda koji je pomeo svijet u to doba. Ovo je prvi film iz trilogije, a Fantômas je postao silno uspješan u Europi, Sovjetskom Savezu i Japanu. Uspio je i u SAD-u gdje dan-danas postoje web-stranice obožavatelja. Opći ton filmova lakši je od originalnih romana Fantômas koje su napisali Pierre Souvestre i Marcel Allain.

programme.title: Honey, film
programme.desc: Honey Danels (Jessica Alba) je lijepa i mlada plesna koreografkinja koja živi u Istočnom Harlemu, u New yorku. Ples je njen život i sve bi dala da uspije. Honey podučava hip hop u lokalnom centru za mlade i trudi se djecu maknuti sa ceste i čuvati ih od neprilika. Na snimanju jednog video spota dobije priliku postati koreografkinja. No, kada joj mentor, poznati redatelj video spotova Michael Ellis (David Moscow) postavi ultimatum - ili će spavati s njim ili će joj ovaj zatvoriti vrata plesnog biznisa, Honey je na mukama što napraviti. Odreći se sna ili morala? Film je osam puta nominiran za različite filmske nagrade: 2004. Black Reel, te sedam nominacija za nagradu Teen Choice.

programme.title: Total Recall: Potpuno sjećanje, film
programme.desc: Total Recall: Potpuno sjećanje, nova je filmska vizija proslavljenog redatelja Lena Wisemana (Underworld, Umri muški 4.0) u kojoj su glavne uloge ostvarili Colin Farrell, Kate Beckinsale, Ethan Hawke, Bill Nighy, Jessica Biel, Bryan Cranston i drugi. Riječ je o akcijskom SF spektaklu smještenom u budućnosti u kojoj se savezne države Euromerica i New Shanghai otimaju za prevlast, a radnik u tvornici (Farrell) počinje sumnjati da je špijun, iako nije ni sam siguran na čijoj se strani nalazi...

programme.title: Plava laguna, film
programme.desc: Nakon brodoloma u južnom Pacifiku, dvoje djece, Emmeline (Brooke Shields) i Richard (Christopher Atkins) te brodski kuhar Paddy (Leo McKern) jedini su preživjeli. No Paddy uskoro premine, stoga su Richard i Emmeline naglo prisiljeni naučiti sve o preživljavanju na pustom otoku, stotinama kilometara daleko od civilizacije. I dok godine prolaze, dječak i djevojčica postaju mladić i djevojka, a otkrivanje vlastite seksualnosti donosi im veliku prekretnicu u obliku djeteta, o čijoj brizi novi roditelji ne znaju gotovo ništa. Povrh svega, na otoku se skriva velika opasnost, koje Richard i Emmeline nisu svjesni... Danas kultni film, "Plava laguna" ostaje u pamćenju kao jedan od ranih filmova Brooke Shields, poznatih po medijskom dizanju prašine. Nakon "Slatke male" Louisa Mallea, u kojoj je prikazan život i seksualno odrastanje djevojčice u javnoj kući, uslijedila je "Plava laguna", niska slobodnih prizora razgolićene Brooke Shields, ovaj put kao petnaestogodišnjakinje. Film Randala Kleisera ekranizacija je romana Henryja DeVerea Stacpoolea iz 1903., intrigantnog djela koje se bavi problematikom odrastanja dječaka i djevojčice posve odvojenih od civilizacije, u nekoj vrsti suvremenog raja. Vjerojatno najveću zaslugu za uspjeh filma snosi legendarni snimatelj španjolskog podrijetla, Nestor Almendros, omiljeni suradnik Françoisa Truffauta i Erica Rohmera.

programme.title: Kućna zečica, film
programme.desc: Shelley Darlington, Playboyeva zečica, živi bezbrižnim životom sve dok se jedna suparnica ne pobrine da bude izbačena iz Plajboyeve vile. Nema kamo otići, a sudbina je odnese u sestrinstvo Zeta Alpha Zeta. Ne uspiju li pridobiti nove članice za svoje sestrinstvo, sedam društveno potpuno neupućenih žena izgubit će svoju kuću koja će tada pripasti djevojkama spletkaricama iz sestrinstva Phi Iota Mu. Da bi postigle svoj cilj, one trebaju Shelley da ih nauči kako se šminkati i kako zavoditi; istovremeno, Shelley treba malo onoga što imaju Zete – osjećaj individualnosti. Ta kombinacija vodi do toga da se sve djevojke prestanu pretvarati i budu ono što zaista jesu.

programme.title: Terminator: Spasenje, film
programme.desc: Smješten u postapokaliptičnu 2018. godinu, John Connor je čovjek predodređen da vodi ljudski pokret otpora protiv Skyneta i njegove vojske Terminatora. No, budućnost u koju Connor vjeruje je promijenjena dolaskom Marcusa Wrighta, stranca čije je posljednje sjećanje kako stoji u redu za strijeljanje. Connor mora odlučiti da li je Marcus poslan iz budućnosti, ili je spašen iz prošlosti. Dok se Skynet priprema za konačni napad, njih dvojica kreću u potragu koja ih dovodi do centra Skynetovih operacija, gdje otkrivaju užasnu tajnu koja se krije iza mogućeg uništenja ljudskog roda...

programme.title: Brži od pravde, film
programme.desc: Nakon 10 godina provedenih u zatvoru, Driveru (Dwayne Johnson) je samo jedno na pameti – osvetiti ubojstvo svog brata koje se zbilo u zapetljanoj pljački banke zbog koje je i sam završio u zatvoru… Konačno dočekavši slobodu, on ima smrtonosan plan… ali dvojica mu muškaraca stoje na putu – Cop (Billy Bob Thornton), policajac kojeg nekoliko dana dijeli od mirovine i mladi egocentrični Killer (Oliver Jackson-Cohen), ubojica s razvijenim instinktom za umjetnost ubijanja. Driverov osvetnički plan postaje utrka na život i smrt jer se misterija oko smrti njegovog brata produbljuje, a na površinu isplivavaju novi detalji koji nagoviještaju da možda neće moći svoj plan provesti do kraja.

programme.title: Brzina ubija
programme.desc: Desert creatures endure searing heat and zero rainfall, but speed is their ticket to survival.A Tiger beetle runs at the human equivalent of 500 miles per hour. A caracal jumps six feet to swat a weaverbird out of midair. And the world’s fastest chameleon hunts on the desert floor.Only the hardiest, fastest animals survive. Nothing else stands a chance.

programme.title: Plavo carstvo
programme.desc: Around the globe, thousands of decommissioned naval vessels rot in dockyards. What can you do with these toxic time bombs? One solution is to clean them well, blow them up and sink them! Providing shelter and breeding grounds, countless fish and invertebrates colonize steel hulls. In the Cayman Islands, the USS Kittiwake met a watery grave and quickly transformed into a vibrant artificial reef. In the Florida Keys, dozens of purposely sunk ships are a beacon to marine life, and to scuba divers. It seems like a win-win-win situation - for the environment, for divers and for cash strapped governments. But supporters face tough opposition on many fronts. After years of struggle, Canada's newest artificial reef project - the HMCS Annapolis, is nearing completion. But will protesters get their way and scuttle the sinking?

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that’s hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods - you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups - you won’t believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that’s a good day at the beach

programme.title: Glazbeni putnik
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Dosjei RIP
programme.desc: The team explores St. Albans, a former sanitarium, and captures several shocking EVPs (spirit voices), including the one that became the title of this episode.

programme.title: Svijet današnjice
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Putovanja kroz povijest
programme.desc: We’ll find out why they called Minneapolis the Mill City when we visit the Mill City Museum. Then we march over to the Union’s Fort Snelling, the first permanent structure in Minnesota, and then head underground and learn about St. Paul’s organized crime hide outs.

programme.title: Putovanja kroz povijest
programme.desc: San Antonio is rich with Texas, Mexican, and Spanish history. We make our last stand at the Alamo, and visit Missions National Historical Park. Lastly, we spelunk the Natural Bridge Caverns underground.

programme.title: Sile prirode
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it’s also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth’s crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo’s Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Sile prirode
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Fishing Prince Rupert, Ha-Nee-Nah Lodge on Dundas Island and Hecate Strait for Chinook Salmon and Pacific Halibut!

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O’Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird’s that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Odlazak u avanturu
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Pokaži mi gdje živiš
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Putovanja po Indiji
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces. We visit Cubbon Park and Lal Bagh Gardens, shop in the markets and explore the nightlife of the modern city. We also explore architecture, from ancient Bull Temple, the legendary source of the Vishva Bharti River to the largest legislative building in India. Bill’s final stop is the Queen of the Hill Stations Ooty, where he tours the plantations, rides the historic narrow-gauge railroad and visits the Stone House, which was built by the British in the days of colonial rule.

programme.title: Putovanja po Indiji
programme.desc: These two national parks have some of the most diverse wildlife found on the Indian subcontinent. From the ancestors of our domesticated livestock to leopards, bear and elephants—this is a photographer’s paradise. Join Bill as he attempts to track down two of the hardest predators to photograph—the leopard and the sloth bear.

programme.title: Putovanja po Africi
programme.desc: All the essentials for going on, and having a successful safari are covered before our host gets a very special challenge—to find at least half of the Big Twelve on one safari drive. Four hours and six (6) very special animals—can he do it using his own rules for a successful safari?

programme.title: Putovanja po Africi
programme.desc: We elect to stay on a few extra days to try and obtain some good leopard footage. These are the most elusive of the Big Twelve and filming them is a major challenge. In the process of tracking leopards, we run across a newborn gazelle trying to walk for the first time. Will it succeed before the predators find it? Can we find and film a leopard up close?

programme.title: Nomadi
programme.desc: Follow some of the biggest names in freestyle motocross as they prepare for the ‘Dew Action Sports Tour,’ being held in Salt Lake City.

programme.title: Nomadi
programme.desc: Top pros and riders meet up for five days of racing in Whistler ski resort for the Crankworx Mountain Bike Festival.

programme.title: Putovanje iz snova
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Pokaži mi gdje živiš
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: Throughout the history of mankind - the business of curing, of understanding and treating disease, has taken a rather peculiar path. Some procedures have proven to be very efficient while other methods could only have made things worse for the patient. Up to the 16th Century ‘treating’ someone could mean diminishing one of four bodily fluids, paving the way for bloodletting. As it turns out, modern science proves that bloodletting does help in rare cases. In fact, bloodsucking leeches are excellent helpers to cure wounds. We now know that one little creature is the cause for many diseases: bacteria. But until the mid-19th century, many felt that such tiny organisms such as germs could not possibly kill larger ones such as humans. After all, we can’t even see them with the naked eye! How then, did we discover them? Thanks to one doctor who decided to take a good look …between his teeth. Since then, we have found a cure for most bacterial infections in the form of Antibiotics. This was accidently discovered by Alexander Fleming - whilst leaving the office for a holiday, he left a culture plate smeared with his personal nasal mucus on his lab bench only to find that mould surrounding this mucus actually inhibited its growth. In the new millennium, this discovery of such a ‘Superdrug’ is threatened by the advent of the ‘Superbug’. Have these cures led to bacteria becoming more tolerant and harder to kill? What else will the future bring? A cure against the flu?

programme.title: Glazbeni putnik
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Sati očaja
programme.desc: Our focus for this chilling but fascinating episode of Desperate Hours is on Nuclear and Industrial Disasters.Nuclear nuclear power depends on harnessing the energy released during one of two processes - nuclear fission, or nuclear fusion.In both Nuclear fusion and nuclear fission, energy is released from the high-powered atomic bonds between the particles within a nucleus. The two processes differ, in that Nuclear Fission means splitting an atom into two, or more, smaller atoms. While Nuclear Fusion, is the fusing of two, or more, smaller atoms into a larger one. Ironically nuclear power is a relatively clean source of energy, which is great. But of course, unless the utmost precautions are taken in generating nuclear power, then the consequences can go beyond merely disastrous, to the unthinkable, the horrific. Safety in the workplace and care for the environment are a human responsibility but when it comes to nuclear power it’s not just industrial accidents that threaten tragic consequences. on an epic scale. A natural disaster such as a volcano or earthquake is something we have little-or-no control over and when such an event strikes a nuclear power facility the resulting disaster can be off the scale and last for decades.

programme.title: Lovci na prošlost
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird’s eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd’s Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray’s cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett’s tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia - the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature - the weedy sea dragon - a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin - the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world - the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters - albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: As Loro Parque’s head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque’s Head of Environmental Affairs, it’s all part of the job! He’s hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research - but first he’s just got to locate the turtle - 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: ‘Finding Nemo’ may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao’s not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Divljaci
programme.desc: Some animals will never be inconspicuous, others blend so perfectly with their surroundings that they can move through them without detection. Camouflaged cats - for many of the cats of Africa, camouflage is key to survival. From the spots of the cheetah, the rosettes of the leopard and the stripes and dots of the serval, these cats have evolved to merge with their habitat. Hidden Lizards - Regal horned lizards vanish into Arizona’s deserts, feeding mostly on ants. Cryptic Snakes - Australia’s death adder and carpet python hide in plain sight. Cuttlefish - Change color, shape, and texture to disappear instantly. Chameleons - Over 100 species, masters of rainforest disguise. Ptarmigans - Snow-white birds of the frozen north. Crab Spiders - Tiny hunters, perfectly matched to bark, leaves, or flowers.

programme.title: Divljaci
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world - the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster - North America’s largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus - Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans. Red-Back Spider - Hidden in messy webs, the female’s scarlet stripe warns of her deadly bite. Sydney Funnel-Web - Aggressive and armed with toxic venom, the male is especially dangerous. Which venomous creature is the deadliest?

programme.title: Plavo carstvo
programme.desc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic - all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution. In the Florida Keys, some practical and novel approaches are making progress in the fight against these Toxic Invaders.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: Nature’s battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: Na velegradskim krovovima
programme.desc: How is life on the city’s roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures: our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world’s rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Plavi svijet
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world’s largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Plavi svijet
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: Few substances in history have had as profound an effect on mankind as gunpowder and yet its discovery was probably an accident! A big bang, for one… Records show that the Chinese were aware of the explosive stuff as early as 300AD. The invention of gunpowder is a bit of a mystery, and so are its ingredients: it was made by mixing sulfur (a yellow stone- hiding deep underground), charcoal (burned wood), and saltpeter (or potassium nitrate) which was the white frosting found on poop that had been given time to settle and get comfortable. As you can imagine, it takes some effort to make gunpowder. But, rulers needed gunpowder. Gunpowder needed saltpeter. And saltpeter needed poop. And so, dukes declared a monopoly on their lands' waste. Until, only 500 years after the Chinese discovered it, we found out why secretions have such an explosive character. It turns out to be caused by microscopic bacteria, which produce the nitrates as byproducts of digestion. The reason why gunpowder explodes is that it burns very fast, and when it burns it releases gases that have a bigger volume than the original powder (similar to how steam is bigger than water is). But the gunpowder from the old days gave off so much smoke that battlefields were literally too smoky to aim. Until, in 1888, Albert Nobel invented a dense smokeless powder explosive called ballistite. And now, is gunpowder about to be replaced?

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: Mankind has been flying for over a century. As early as the 1500s Leonardo da Vinci tried to build a flying machine. Drawing inspiration from birds he gave it wings. Unfortunately, his ‘Ornithopter’ didn’t work, and indeed, the airplanes of today do not have flapping wings! We also tried it with balloons. Huge 245-metre long airships that needed the guts of between 80,000 to 200,000 cows! But, it was the kite that became the forerunner of the flying machine. A kite made by the now famous Wright brothers. The two brothers were bicycle repairmen, which convinced them that a flying machine could be highly unstable and yet controllable, such as with bicycles. They built their kites as strong as their bicycle frames and used bicycle parts to test their workings. The early Wright planes could manage no more than 65 km/h. Nowadays, a commercial plane can top 800 km/h. What is it that make our current planes fly 12 times faster? Well, one British Royal Air pilot, Frank Whittle, remembered his school experiments with the ‘Aeolipile’, a piece of ancient Greek engineering. This pilot argued that we could fly faster - if we’d fly higher - because there is less air resistance at high altitudes. The future of aviation has lead to Airbus’s A380, the largest passenger plane in the world as well as the scramjet built by NASA. So what will be the next quirky discovery for flight?

programme.title: Oh, to nisam znao!
programme.desc: Before computer drawing programs, there was a toy that if you mastered its two circular white knobs you could have a picture perfect SKETCH. We’ll explain how the ETCH A SKETCH drew onto the scene. And what did Neil Armstrong REALLY say when he stepped on the moon, the aahh answer will surprise you! Plus, where did the explosive name BIKINI come from?

Plus, find out how a melting chocolate bar gave way to the invention of the MICROWAVE!

programme.title: Ukradena remek djela
programme.desc: It’s the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Čudo
programme.desc: Chromatic adaptation lets humans perceive consistent colors despite changing light. Some animals change color using chromatophores—for camouflage or signaling. Pink isn’t a real wavelength; our brains create it by blending light. Blue is rare in nature but appears through structural features in feathers and wings. Snow camouflage helps animals blend into winter landscapes using shades of white and gray.

programme.desc: The Monty Hall Problem shows switching choices boosts winning odds. The Birthday Problem reveals how just 23 people can have a 50% chance of shared birthdays due to multiple pairings. Gambler’s Ruin proves that in a fair game, the smaller bankroll loses over time. The Infinite Hotel Paradox explores the strange logic of infinity. The Locker Riddle uses factorization to reveal why only lockers with perfect square numbers stay open.

programme.title: Svakodnevni elementi
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Pokaži mi gdje živiš
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Glazbeni putnik
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia - the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature - the weedy sea dragon - a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin - the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world - the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters - albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy’s ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia’s wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada

Olive Ridley Turtles - The world’s most abundant sea turtle, migrating vast distances to nest. Sooty Tern - These seabirds may stay airborne for years before returning to land to breed. Australian Pelicans - Big-billed birds that follow inland waterways in search of fish. Whales & Whale Sharks - Ocean giants that roam the seas, some on epic migrations we barely understand. Some of the greatest migratory animals on earth are those that live in its waters and traverse its great oceans. From baleen whales that travel from the nutrient rich polar waters and the whale sharks whose migrations we barely understand.

programme.title: Divljaci
programme.desc: Archer Fish - A precise hunter, it shoots water jets to knock prey from above. Portia Spider - Tiny but smart, this spider hunts others with strategy and speed. Cone Shell - A slow-moving snail with a deadly harpoon for catching fish. Bolas Spider - Spins sticky globules to snare prey in the dark. Slave-Making Ants - Some ants enslave others to build their colonies. Ant Lion - A fierce larva that traps ants in sandy pits. Pompilid Wasp - Hunts spiders with deadly precision. Who rules the micro predator world?

programme.title: Plavo carstvo
programme.desc: Around the globe, thousands of decommissioned naval vessels rot in dockyards. What can you do with these toxic time bombs? One solution is to clean them well, blow them up and sink them! Providing shelter and breeding grounds, countless fish and invertebrates colonize steel hulls. In the Cayman Islands, the USS Kittiwake met a watery grave and quickly transformed into a vibrant artificial reef. In the Florida Keys, dozens of purposely sunk ships are a beacon to marine life, and to scuba divers. It seems like a win-win-win situation - for the environment, for divers and for cash strapped governments. But supporters face tough opposition on many fronts. After years of struggle, Canada's newest artificial reef project - the HMCS Annapolis, is nearing completion. But will protesters get their way and scuttle the sinking?

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: Nature’s battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: In nature, both males and females fight fiercely—especially females defending their young. Most battles occur within the same species over food, territory, status, or mates. While not always fatal, these fights can lead to death. Animals protect food sources directly or by defending territory rich in prey. This territorial aggression helps distribute populations but can also limit them—like wolves starving without territory. Though fighting can secure survival, it comes at a cost: injury, exhaustion, and death. Often, avoiding conflict is the wisest strategy.

programme.title: Na velegradskim krovovima

By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world’s rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Plavi svijet
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan investigates the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world!

programme.title: Plavi svijet
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It’s rumored to be the clearest water in the world. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean’s most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: Cooling is more than a luxury. Nowadays it is a necessity. Without refrigerated shipping and stocking, fresh food wouldn’t reach our supermarket so easily. Can you imagine living without it? Before the invention of the refrigerator, icehouses were used to provide cool storage for most of the year. To cool our food and beverages, blocks of ice were simply cut out of frozen lakes and shipped to far and beyond. The so-called ‘ice-industry’ came to its end when, in the late 1900s, our waters became too polluted to serve as a cool preserving agent. Air-conditioning, on the other hand, was actually invented to control the humidity that was ruining the paper of printing offices, rather than the technology being used to cool you off. The quirky part is, you can’t create cold; you can only ‘move’ temperature form one place to another. The first one to find a technology that cooled the inside of a box - the forefather of the refrigerator - was a medical doctor. In fact, he thought he was building a machine to cure malaria. And yet it took over a century after that, before people started using refrigerators, because refrigerators were thought to be dangerous. And they had a point! For a few decades, the refrigerator was something of a killer machine (literally) as they omitted toxic gases that poisoned people… Even Einstein got worried and developed a cooling-machine. And when refrigerators stopped killing people, scientists discovered that refrigerants were harming the environment. All sorts of chemicals have passed through our refrigerator coils, to be discarded… but perhaps we have a new solution: cooling with the vibrations of sound. That does sound cool.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: In contrast with popular belief, Edison did not invent the light bulb. Many people contributed to the invention. Mind you, the first lamp was invented around 70,000 BC. Once upon a time we had limelight, which was actually quite unsafe, and then there were arc arc lamps - shedding light that blinded movie stars up to the point where they had to wear sunglasses. What Edison did was improve the light bulb to become a practical, affordable and safe product. He tested over 5000 filaments to make the bulb last: from bamboo fiber to a hair out of an assistant’s beard. At the same time others were working on light bulbs made with gasses, which we now know as energy efficient lamps. Modern-day lighting innovations are quite startling, a lot of them - we can’t even see with the naked eye… Lasers, for example. For the longest time it was merely a pet-theory of the grand Einstein. Nobody knew what to make of this idea that ‘atoms could release their excess energy as light’ When the laser was invented, people joked that the laser was ‘a solution looking for a problem’. Now it is omnipresent. In the near future: laser-light therapy by flashing the human brain.

programme.title: Oh, to nisam znao!
programme.desc: It was the purrrfect idea for making our furry friends more pleasant around the house! You’ll learn how litty litter clawed its way into our homes. And you’ll learn how a garment made out of special woven fibers can stop a bullet, plus, why is walking under a ladder bad luck? And finally, we’ll "cut to the chase" and explain the history behind this common phrase!

We’ll explain why and how it was saved! Then, you’ll visit America’s FIRST PIZZERIA! And how the gourmet ice cream HAAGEN DAZS got its exotic start in Bronx New York!

These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Svakodnevni elementi
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Brodovi i ljudi
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Putovanje iz snova
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Maćeha iz pakla, film
programme.desc: Izzy počinje sumnjati da se njena nova maćeha i polusestra žele domoći imetka njenog oca, kojem se zdravlje naglo počelo pogoršavati. Njen se život pretvori u noćnu moru nakon što otkrije pronevjeru i podmićivanje u obiteljskom poslu, za što će netko ubiti kako bi to zaštitio.

programme.title: Sponzor, film
programme.desc: Darren (Kelly McCormack) opako je talentirana i nekonvencionalna mlada glazbenica koja sanja o stvaranju glazbe kakvu nitko dosad nije čuo. No ona je švorc, žonglira s više poslova s nepunim radnim vremenom i nema vremena za stvaranje. Očajnički tražeći gotovinu, prijavljuje se na web-stranicu za sastanke koji se plaćaju i baca se u mračnu zečju rupu koja je tjera da brzo odraste oblikujući njezinu glazbu i način na koji vidi svijet.

programme.title: Opasnost u Rusiji, film
programme.desc: Judd je sredovječni američki odvjetnik koji poslovno dolazi u St. Petersburg, gdje u njegov auto upada atraktivna Ruskinja Saša, tvrdeći da bježi od svodnika. Juddu se mlada žena jako svidi pa joj odluči pomoći. Ispada da je Saša ukrala dragocjenu tijaru kriminalcima koji su je otuđili iz Ermitaža s namjerom da je prodaju izvan Rusije. Patriotski nastrojena Saša to nije željela dopustiti i sad je nevolji. Njezin poočim jedina je osoba kojoj vjeruje, ali uskoro shvati da i u Judda može imati puno povjerenje, štoviše, on joj pruža dragocjenu pomoć, a uskoro se njih dvoje i zaljube...

programme.title: Ljubav i Mary, film
programme.desc: Mary je profinjena slastičarka. Trudi se održati svoju pekaru, ali jednog dana je izbacivanje iz poslovna prostora primorava na zatvaranje posla. Mary sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati k svojoj obitelji u Teksas od koje treba dobiti zaručnički poklon. Na njezinu nesreću Brent dobiva napadaj alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Mary odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentova identičnog brata blizanca koji je netom izišao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga obitelji kao svojeg zaručnika. Hoće li to biti dobra ideja?

programme.title: Ljetni kamp za obuku, film
programme.desc: Whitney Carmichael, nesklona sportu, prijavljuje se na intenzivni ljetni kamp za obuku kako bi došla u tjelesnu formu i tamo se zaljubljuje u osobnog trenera. Zatim pronalazi snagu prihvatiti svoje 'pravo ja' i ignorirati očekivanja drugih.

programme.title: Njuškalo i ukleti dvorac, film
programme.desc: Njemačkog ovčara Sniffa je odgojio Tom. Naučio je psa vrlo posebnim vještinama, a njih dvoje i Tomova djevojka Mirjam doživljavaju uzbudljive avanture. Tijekom ljetnih praznika Tom je s Mirjam i Sniffom ostao kod ujaka Hansa i nećaka Jaapa. Čuli su za dvorac s duhovima u susjedstvu. Legenda o dvorcu kaže da se u Srednjem vijeku izvjesni vitez Betram zaljubio u sluškinju Ada, koja je voljela konjušara. Betram se odlučio osvetiti njima dvoje groznim ponašanjem, a govori se da je od tada šuma oko dvorca ukleta. Na putu kroz šumu do dvorca, Tom, Mirjam i Sniff naiđu na bandu krijumčara. To ih odvede u još jednu uzbudljivu avanturu....

programme.title: Pisac iz sjene, film
programme.desc: On je pisac iz sjene (E. McGregor) i za pozamašnu svotu treba urediti memoare Adama Langa (P. Brosnan), bivšeg britanskog premijera, čiji je dotadašnji stalni suradnik smrtno stradao. Nakon dugogodišnjeg sudjelovanja u politici Lang je otišao u mirovinu i preselio se sa ženom i osobljem u Ameriku gdje živi izolirano i piše. Novi pisac ubrzo je uvučen u političke i seksualne intrige s Langovom ženom Ruth (O. Williams) i njezinom pomoćnicom (K. Kattrall), a Langu su počele opasno prijetiti tajne iz prošlosti... Film je snimljen prema romanu "The Ghost" Roberta Harrisa koji je zajedno s redateljem Polanskim napisao scenarij. Film je dobio mnogobrojne nagrade, osobito Polanski za režiju (Berlin) te glumci E. McGregor za glavnu ulogu bezimenog pisca i Olivia Williams za ulogu Langove žene. Većina kritičara se slaže da je Polanski vješto pretočio roman u napeti politički triler.

Barbaro ga smiruje i govori mu da je posao s kranom spreman - uskoro će oni biti kraljevi grada.

programme.title: Njuškalo u ratu, film
programme.desc: Nakon što su mu roditelji poginuli u bombardiranju u 2.svj.ratu, Toma su poslali živjeti kod rođaka na farmu u Nizozemskoj. Tužan je, ljut i uplašen, te odbija živjeti s ujakom i ujnom. Ali kada Tom dobije mladog njemačkog ovčara Sniffa o kojem će brinuti, sve se mijenja. Jako vjeruje Sniffu i zajedno pokušavaju izvući najbolje od života, iako je njihovo selo pod njemačkom kontrolom. With Sniff's help, Tom rescues a Dutch pilot that's been shot down and wounded. But when a Dutch Nazi collaborator sends soldiers to search for the pilot, it's up to Sniff and Tom to expose the traitor. The pilot escapes back to his unit and Sniff leads the troops back to liberate the town. SNIFF THE Ratni HERO is deliverable in two formats: A feature length film and also as 4 broadcast half-hours.

programme.title: Veličanstveni Ambersoni, film
programme.desc: Vrlo razmažen i izuzetno nesimpatičan bogati mladić George Amberson postane užasnut kad se njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, ponovo poveže s imućnim Eugeneom Morganom, kojeg je ostavila desetljećima ranije, kako bi se udala za Georgeovog oca. Dok George nastoji sabotirati majčinu romansu, mora se nositi i s vlastitim romantičnim osjećajima prema Morganovoj kćeri, kao i s posljedicama svog uplitanja, dok njegova, nekoć velika obitelj, propada zbog njegovih makinacija...

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i rezanci, film
programme.desc: Sredovječni Wang vlasnik je trgovine tjesteninom, već prilično umoran od 10-godišnjeg braka bez djece s privlačnom suprugom. I njegova supruga želi prekinuti takav brak, pa Wanga već neko vrijeme vara s Lijem. Njezino razočaranje brakom je toliko da ona od skupine perzijskih putujućih trgovaca oružjem kupi pištolj. A kad dozna da mu je supruga nevjerna, te da je nabavila i oružje, Wang je odluči ubiti. Za to angažira beskrupuloznog policajca Zhanga...

programme.title: Satin, film
programme.desc: Pjevač Jack Satin bez novca je i bez posla, ali opsjednut je težnjom za slavom. Kada je prisiljen napustiti Las Vegas, spakira stvari u stari Cadillac i zaputi se prema Atlantic Cityju. Ubrzo mu se pokvari auto zbog čega zapne u gradiću Lost Springsu. Ondje upozna džez-legendu Doca Bishopa koji mu pomogne u nevolji s automobilom. Iako je daleko od svjetla pozornice, Jack se počinje osjećati kao kod kuće u malom gradiću. Nakon što upozna zgodnu konobaricu Lauren Wells, Jack uvidi da je život mnogo više od slave i bogatstva.

programme.title: Ljubavni brodolom, film
programme.desc: Jenny Taylor (Amanda Bynes) našla je svojeg idealnog muškarca za kojeg je sigurna da će je potpuno osvojiti. No, postoji jedan problem. Njen idealan muškarac je Jason Masters (Chris Carmack), najveća rock-zvijezda na svijetu. Nadajući se da će dobiti priliku i približiti se svojem idolu, Jenny se zapošljava u njegovom omiljenom karipskom odmaralištu, St. Luchasu, zajedno s Ryanom (Jonathan Bennett). Dok joj Ryan pomaže dajući joj savjete od kojih će joj pomoći da preživi na otoku, Ryanov prijatelj mu daje savjete kako se udvarati Jenny. Ryan se potpuno promijeni, no kada ga Jenny vidi, govori samo o Jasonu. Ryan se loše osjeća i odluči otići, no zaustavi auto nasred puta, iziđe i poljubi je. Kaže joj da su stvoreni jedno za drugo, no Jenny mu kaže da su samo prijatelji. Kada to čuje, grozno se osjeća te nju ostavi na cesti, a on uđe u auto i kaže da se vraća kući. Jenny postane žao te se odluči ispričati. Ona je još na drugoj strani otoka kada se Ryan počne spremati za povratak kući. U tom se trenutku pročuje vijest da će snažna oluja pogoditi St. Luchas. Jenny ne zna što se sprema, a Ryan se požuri kako bi je spasio. Kada Jason za vrijeme oluje završi u moru, Jenny skoči za njim kako bi ga spasila te se oboje nađu na naoko pustom tropskom otoku. Jenny shvati da su samo nekoliko kilometara udaljeni od odmarališta, no umjesto da Jasonu kaže istinu, ona ga ostavi u uvjerenju da su se nasukali kako bi ga natjerala da se zaljubi u nju. Kada otkrije njezin plan, Jennyna se suparnica Alexis (Jamie-Lynn Discala) odluči pretvarati da se i ona nasukala. Jennyn se plan počne raspadati te shvati da joj je savršena ljubav cijelo vrijeme pred nosom.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću, film
programme.desc: Tko kaže da morate pobijediti, da biste bili prvak? Slava Kolotiloff, učitelj iz uspavanog priobalnog grada po nazivu "Prsti" dolazi osvojiti Moskvu s rukopisom svoje prve novele. Umjesto toga, posve slučajno, osvaja srce prelijepe Nadie (Milla Jovovich). Dok se njihovo vjenčanje približava, Slava treba prekinuti njegov posao i privesti kraju nedovršene poslove u "Prstima" prije povratka u Moskvu, gdje će početi novi život sa svojom mladenkom. Ali uslijed više bizarnih okolnosti, ne može otići, ali se organiziranje vjenčanja ipak nastavlja, a Nadia se mora oduprijeti pažnji bivšeg dečka Danya, koji je spreman učiniti sve što je potrebno, kako bi je ponovo osvojio.

programme.title: Kako se zaljubiti u New Yorku, film
programme.desc: Nekada davno u čarobnom kraljevstvu New Yorka, gradu koji ne spava, ali puno spava okolo, zemlji najbolje pizze na svijetu i prenapučenim podzemnim željeznicama, dvoje milenijalca Milo i Wendy pronalaze se preko aplikacije za upoznavanje „Cute dating. Nakon veze za jednu noć, čarolija New Yorka ih ponovno spaja te odlučuju postati „najbolji prijatelji s povlasticama kako bi izbjegli zamke veze. Hoće li se prijateljstvo i seks pomiješati bez ikakvih komplikacija? Uz pomoć vratara Colea i njihovih prijatelja Hanka i Jessie koji se također nose s vlastitim komplikacijama nove veze, Milo i Wendy mogli bi pronaći ono što traže.

programme.title: Bijele laži, film
programme.desc: Privlačna Barbara Cates (E. Eleniak) uspješna je mlada poslovna žena koja se ozbiljno zabrine doznavši da je njezinu najbolju prijateljicu i kolegicu Liz Garnett (M. Schnarre) u garaži njihove poslovne zgrade napao nepoznati maskirani muškarac. Barbara poznaje Liz još od djetinjstva, i vjeruje da među njima dvjema od prvog dana nema baš nikakvih tajni. Premda se neko vrijeme nisu viđale, Barbara zna da je Liz prije nekoliko godina bila u vezi s agresivnim Daleom, nasilnikom i kriminalcem koji je u međuvremenu uhićen i osuđen na zatvorsku kaznu. A Barbara je već nekoliko mjeseci u sretnoj vezi s markantnim Gunnarom Davisom (P. Dobson), dečkom za kojeg se nada da je konačno onaj pravi. Kad ju Liz s objašnjenjem da se želi od svega odmoriti pozove na vikend - izlet u kolibu na snijegom prekrivenoj planini, Barbara sa zadovoljstvom pristane. Ne zna, međutim, da Liz namjerava sa sobom ponijeti i kovčeg s dva milijuna dolara, novcem koji je ukrala Daleu prije njegovog odlaska u zatvor. Tijekom vožnje u planinu Liz iznenađenoj Barbari otkrije da je Dale prije nekoliko mjeseci izišao iz zatvora, te da vjeruje da ju je upravo on napao one večeri. Štoviše, Liz već danima netko prati u crvenom automobilu, a isti takav automobil slijedi ih i na izletu. Kad o svemu mobitelom obavijesti Gunnara, Barbara ni ne sluti da je pred njima vikend tijekom kojeg će na kocku staviti i vlastite živote... Raspoloženi nastup privlačne E. Eleniak (E. T., Mjehur ubojica, Pod opsadom, Dracula 3000, Fatal Reunion), nekadašnje Playboyeve "zečice" koja se razmjerno uspješno okušala i kao glumica, a koja je najveću gledateljsku popularnost stekla ulogom u hit serijalu Spasilačka služba, najjači je adut atraktivnog, uzbudljivog i nepretencioznog trilera redatelja Rubena Preussa (Write to Kill, Almost Dead, Dead on Sight, The Art of Murder). Scenarij Georgea Ferrisa (Tainted Love, Running Red, The Night Witch) se dosta spretno poigrava očekivanjima gledatelja, i gradi priču o prevari, laži i dvostrukim identitetima protagonista nejasne prošlosti. Uz E. Eleniak nastupa i top-model M. Scharre (Junior, Mirotvorac, serije Petak 13., Beverly Hills 90210), a u sporednoj ulozi gledamo P. Dobsona (Posljednji izlaz za Brooklyn, Forrest Gump, Norma Jean & Marilyn, Zastrašivači, Lansky, Tko je utopio Monu).

programme.title: Gorko/slatko, film
programme.desc: „Gorko/slatko“ romantična je komedija vođena karakterizacijom likova koje postavlja u neobične, netipične situacije. Film je priča o američkom stručnjaku za kavu Brianu Chandleru (Kip Pardue) koji naizgled ima savršen život. No stvari se počnu mijenjati kada ga njegov šef, odmetnuti magnat i proizvođač kave Calvert Jenkins (James Brolin) pošalje na Tajland na inspekciju usjeva. Pri dolasku Brian upoznaje Tichu (Mamee Nakprasit), bankošku direktoricu koja se brine za glamuroznu, darovitu divu, Tajlanđanku Tatu Young (Tata Young). Budući da je uvijek zaposlena, Ticha je već odavno odustala od potrage za pravom ljubavi. Na nagovor roditelja, uzgajivača kave, Nee i Surapong (Viyada Umarin i Sompop Benjadhikul) koji se nadaju da će Brian kupiti kavu kod njih i spasiti selo od okrutnog posrednika Kanga (Arun Whasadeewong), Ticha pristaje dovesti Briana na plantaže kave u Južni Krabi i pomiriti se sa svojom prošlosti. Zanimljive dodatne zaplete u priči donose i Tichina vatrena sestra Mint (Pakaramai Potranan) i njezin naočit dečko boksač Komane (Akara Amatayakul), njezina pristupačna i otvorena najbolja prijateljica Mook (Kalorin Nemayothin) i njezin urnebesno smiješan dečko Austrijanac Werner (Spencer Garrett), kao i Brianova prelijepa zaručnica Amanda (Laura Sorenson). Brian i Ticha "ista su strana različitih medalja" i zato se neprestano sudaraju. No kad ih putovanje odvede iz velegradske vreve Bangkoka u Krabi, pitoreskni krš okružen plantažama kave, i Biran i Tiha počinju shvaćati da su stvoreni jedno za drugo.

programme.title: Što sve činimo zbog ljubavi, TV film
programme.desc: Nezadovoljna poslom u maloj posredničkoj tvrtki, Sophie daje otkaz i odlazi raditi u poznatu agenciju za osobno i bračno savjetovanje na Manhattnu. Uvijek spremna za nove izazove, bez razmišljanja prihvaća posao savjetnice. No ubrzo se sukobi s glavnim trenerom i zavodnikom Jasonom Sharpeom, koji je ujedno i sin direktora agencija. Jason je šarmantni nevaljalac koji s lakoćom pronalazi put do ljudskih srca. Njih su dvoje prisiljeni raditi zajedno. Hoće li uspjeti sačuvati ugled agencije? Ili će ovaj dvojac neslavno propasti?

programme.title: Ljubavnica, serija
programme.desc: Eun-soo pronalazi glavnog osumnjičenika za Min-jaeovo ubojstvo, samo da bi ga pronašla mrtvog. Da stvar bude gora, na mjestu događaja pronađeni su otisci prstiju Se-yeoninog "mrtvog" supruga, Young-daea. Unatoč tome što je konačno ostvarila svoj san o trudnoći, Jung-won obuzima nekontrolirani strah. Hwa-young shvaća da je svaka tragedija povezana s jednim incidentom iz prošlosti.

programme.title: Ljubavnica, serija
programme.desc: Muškarac koji je trebao biti mrtav, Young-dae, stoji pred Se-yeon. Mora donijeti odluku koja mijenja život za svoju bolesnu kćer dok dadilja, Jung-shim, pokazuje svoje pravo lice i počinje s ucjenom. Eun-soo i Hwa-young prate Sang-hoona dok istražuju sumnjivu smrt, a Jung-won je slomljena skrivenim motivima svog supruga Dong-seoka.

programme.title: Ljubavnica, serija
programme.desc: Konačno se otkriva identitet muškarca koji je imao aferu sa žrtvom požara u radionici svijeća. Dok pokušava postići dogovor s Jung-shimom, Se-yeon dobiva šokantan medicinski izvještaj. Jung-won provjerava nadzorne kamere u Dong-seokovom restoranu i paralizirana je onim što vidi. Misterij oko četiri žene doseže točku ključanja.

programme.title: You shall not sleep tonight, film
programme.desc: Dječaka progone zastrašujuće noćne more u kojima čudovište vreba u ormaru. Na njegovo olakšanje, njegov otac se pojavljuje usred noći i pomaže mu da se suoči sa svojim strahovima. No dječak će početi preispitivati ​​pravu prirodu ovih ukazanja, suočiti se s istinom o očevoj sudbini i zloj sili koja prijeti da ga proguta.

programme.title: Bitka za Saipan, film
programme.desc: Kad bolnicu američke vojske na udaljenom otoku Saipan preplave japanske snage, usamljeni bolničar stavlja sve na kocku, kako bi skupinu ranjenih ratnika odveo na sigurno u ovoj napetoj epopeji iz Drugog svjetskog rata.

programme.title: Bitka za Saipan, film
programme.desc: Kad bolnicu američke vojske na udaljenom otoku Saipan preplave japanske snage, usamljeni bolničar stavlja sve na kocku, kako bi skupinu ranjenih ratnika odveo na sigurno u ovoj napetoj epopeji iz Drugog svjetskog rata.

programme.title: Vatrom na vatru, film
programme.desc: Nakon što svjedoči brutalnom ubojstvu vlasnika trgovine i njegovog sina, vatrogasac Jeremy Coleman (Josh Duhamel) jedva izvuče živu glavu. Ubojica je Hagan (Vincent D’Onofrio), mafijaški boss arijevske bande, koji je odgovoran i za smrt drugog policajaca, kolege detektiva Mikea Cellea (Bruce Wills). Hagan je uhićen i Jeremy ga identificira kao počinitelja. Nakon svjedočenja prisiljen je promijeniti ime i stavljen je u program zaštite svjedoka. Iako mu teško pada promjena života, Jeremy upoznaje Taliju Durham (Rosario Dawson), zamjenicu šerifa, a njihov profesionalni odnos se postepeno razvije u romancu.

programme.title: Djeca bez granica, film
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste i Becca su tri nevjerojatna izopćenika iz srednje škole koji formiraju klub u napuštenom kazalištu. Tamo upoznaju Charlieja (Bill Cobbs, Noć u muzeju), beskućnika koji dijeli njihovu strast prema glazbenom kazalištu. Kad je predviđeno rušenje kazališta, tinejdžeri ga odluče spasiti modernom izvedbom Shakespeareove 'Puno buke ni oko čega'. Usput, grupa uči odnositi se prema drugima s poštovanjem i braniti svoja uvjerenja. Kanal Dove je odobrio ovaj film, u kojem nastupa i Lee Meriwether, nominiran za Emmy i Zlatni globus.

programme.title: Maraton, film
programme.desc: Mlađi zaposlenik Youssoef predlaže da četvorica ljudi sudjeluju u maratonu i pronađu sponzora. Oni pristaju i Youssoef im postaje trener. No, isprva treninzi nalikuju sprdnji. Stanje ljudi koji puše, piju, jedu kolače i uglavnom provode dane u kartanju, jednostavno je odvratno. Ni kućne prilike im nisu sjajne. Svi imaju vlastite probleme. Unatoč nadahnjujućem ohrabrivanju trenera Youssoefa, oni jednostavno nisu u stanju pratiti gusti raspored treninga. Prvi pravi ispit, utrka u Amsterdamu, pretvara se u potpunu katastrofu. Nakon Youssoefove 'jezikove juhe', dečki se trgnu i postanu skoro fanatični. Međutim, trenirajući za maraton, postaju svjesni kako je u pitanju mnogo više od pukog zadržavanja garaže...

programme.title: Postolar, film
programme.desc: Max Simkin popravlja cipele u trgovini u New Yorku koja je u vlasništvu njegove obitelji veće nekoliko generacija. Nezadovoljan svojim životom, Max slučajno naiđe na magičnu dragocjenost koja mu omogući da vidi svijet iz perspektive svojih klijenata.

programme.title: Nas dvojica, film
programme.desc: Jean-Christian Ranu (Daniel Auteuil) je malo ekscentričan računovođa koji živi iz dana u dan. Gilles Gabriel (Alain Chabat) je, zauzvrat, pjevač pop glazbe, koji je jednom imao svojih pet minuta. Nitko nikada ne bi očekivao da se životi ove dvojice vrlo različitih ljudi mogu odjednom povezati. Zvijezda se sada priprema za svoj veliki povratak na scenu, ali naivni planovi naglo se prekidaju kad udara Rana automobilom. Nakon oporavljanja žrtva s užasom otkriva da se u njegovoj glavi pojavio neki drugi glas. Ispostavlja se da je Gabriel umro i na neobjašnjiv način se naselio u umu knjigovođe. Od tog vremena, Ranu postaje dvije osobe u jednom tijelu ...

programme.title: Projekt dinosaur, film
programme.desc: Britanska ekspedicija koja okuplja glavnog istraživača Jonathana Marchanta, njegovog asistenta, doktora i televizijsku ekipu, putuje u Kongo kako bi pronašla dokaze o postojanju dinosaura. Lokalni vodič i pilot helikoptera pridružuju se timu te se grupa zaputi u džunglu. Tijekom putovanja, oni pronalaze slijepog putnika u helikopteru, Jonathanovog sina. Uskoro helikopter napadaju leteća bića te on pada u džunglu na početku poslijednjeg putovanja Jonathana Merchanta i njegova sina.

programme.title: Zaboravljeni, film
programme.desc: Kad ga izbace iz stana, prisiljen je spavati na ulici, no George zatraži utočište u bolnici Bellevue, prihvatnom centaru za beskućnike na Mahnattanu, gdje mu prijateljstvo s još jednim korisnikom centra pomogne da popravi svoj odnos s kćeri.

programme.title: Vidimo se u rujnu, film
programme.desc: Romantična komedija smještena na suvremeni Manhattan. U središtu radnje je Lindsay, djevojka koja ima sve osim prave ljubavi...

programme.title: Kako se piše ljubav, film
programme.desc: Keith Michaels (Hugh Grant) nekoć je bio nagrađivani holivudski scenarist, no danas je u dugovima i bez inspiracije. Stoga je primoran prihvatiti posao gostujućeg predavača na malom koledžu. Iako se isprva nada da će u posao uložiti minimalan trud kako bi se mogao posvetiti svojem novom scenariju, Keith se sve više uključuje u živote svojih studenata među kojima je Holly (Marisa Tomei), samohrana majka koja nastoji okrenuti novu stranicu u životu.
